dailyAllowanceUpToUVGMaximumInsured.description: Indicates whether daily allowance up to the UVG maximum is insured.

dailyAllowanceUpToUVGMaximumStages.description: Daily allowance stages up to the UVG maximum in chronological order. Single entry if daily allowance is not staggered. Up to 3 entries if staggered, for first, second and third daily allowance

dailyAllowanceFirstTwoDaysInsured.description: Indicates whether a specific day 1 and 2 daily allowance is insured.

dailyAllowanceFirstTwoDaysBenefitPercent.description: Benefit amount in percent for the first two days (whole number).

dailyAllowanceAboveUVGMaximumInsured.description: Indicates whether daily allowance above the UVG maximum is insured.

dailyAllowanceAboveUVGMaximumStages.description: Daily allowance stages above the UVG maximum in chronological order. Single entry if daily allowance is not staggered. Up to 3 entries if staggered, for first, second and third daily allowance.

disabilityPensionAboveUVGMaximumInsured.description: Indicates whether disability pension above the UVG maximum is insured.

disabilityCapitalUpToUVGMaximum.description: Disability capital up to the UVG maximum.

disabilityCapitalAboveUVGMaximum.description: Disability capital above the UVG maximum.

survivorsPensionAboveUVGMaximumInsured.description: Indicates whether survivors pension above the UVG maximum is insured.

differenceCoverageInsured.description: Indicates whether difference coverage is insured.
